Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Half-Moon Industrial Rustic Bookcase, 54"W, Dark Fir Finish with Bronze Accents
Materials: Stone
The seamless marriage of cool black metal and warm dark-fir finished wood make this 4-shelf bookcase a versatile addition to any room. The half-moon frame design and sturdy metal supports hold your collection in style. 54”W x 13.75”D x 41.8”H Metal half-moon frame adds elegance and style to this 4-shelf bookcase A low height profile makes this bookcase ideal for displays against busy walls Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
